title: Zsh command history
whyItMatters: Every command typed in a zsh shell is saved here, including server names, paths and commands run against private data.
source: zsh manual, Parameters: HISTFILE defaults to ~/.zsh_history and SAVEHIST controls how many lines are kept: https://zsh.sourceforge.io/Doc/Release/Parameters.html
notes: With EXTENDED_HISTORY each line carries a timestamp, which turns the file into an activity log. ZDOTDIR and HISTFILE can move it elsewhere.
